long_biography.plain_text:
Engineering was David Alkosser's starting point. After studying at Cal Poly, he worked as an industrial engineer before turning to real-estate ownership and management. He and Alice Alkosser pooled their resources to found a company that he grew across several states. DTI Investments now operates apartment properties in California and Texas, with Alkosser serving as both an executive and the named owner of individual communities.

A Napa Valley property acquisition broadened that experience into agriculture and hospitality. The couple developed Shadybrook Estate Winery and expanded through Rapp Ranch and additional vineyard properties. They remain the winery's proprietors, overseeing an estate that combines wine production, tastings and equestrian facilities.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable record links David Alkosser to both Adamar and Silhouette. Florida records independently connect his exact name and the same David and Alice Alko 920 Family Trust to ADAMAR MY LLC and SILHOUETTE 920, LLC. This dual vessel-entity bridge, together with the distinctive name, DTI and winery evidence, resolves the person at very high confidence without relying on a yacht-owner article.

Strong sources consistently use David Alkosser, so no name correction is needed and no middle name is proposed. The upstream American nationality, United States residence and birth-country fields are plausible but were not independently established by an official citizenship, residence or birth record; they are preserved rather than re-proposed.

No strong source reviewed gives Alkosser's birthplace or full birth date, so those researchable fields remain blank. The upstream Alive status is consistent with current 2026 corporate, winery and regulator evidence. Death fields remain inapplicable and no age is inferred from a donor quote.

Real Estate is supported by the first-party founding account, current DTI executive record, government apartment-owner filings and long historical taxpayer evidence. Public records do not disclose personal income, current net asset value or the relative economics of every property, but the evidence is sufficient to distinguish the multistate housing business from the later winery venture.

Self-made rests on the first-party account that David and Alice pooled their resources to found their company after his industrial-engineering start, plus UCLA's independent account and David's statement that they started with very little. The record does not disclose initial financing or every early partner, so the classification does not imply sole creation or quantify each spouse's contribution.

Operator is preferred because Alkosser grew the property company, remains recorded as DTI's chief executive and other officers, is directly identified as apartment-property owner, and is a Shadybrook proprietor involved in estate development. Founder alone would understate his continuing management, while investor would understate the operating evidence.

Multifamily housing is the defining approved tag because sustained apartment ownership and management is the documented wealth platform. Wine production is also eligible through more than a decade of proprietor control, vineyard acquisitions and winery operation. Broader Commercial real estate, Hospitality real estate and Residential development tags are omitted to keep the assignment minimal and avoid overlapping or less precise groupings.

The exact LinkedIn and Shadybrook's official family page are proposed. No exact personal website or Instagram account cleared the identity and relevance threshold, and the DTI website listed by D&B was not used as a proposal because a comparably informative first-party leadership page was not verified.

The upstream biography is couple-led, begins with Alice's food-development background, embeds a source link and uses promotional claims about awards, acreage and destinations. The proposed owner-specific replacement foregrounds David's real-estate wealth mechanism and durable winery role while retaining only facts that strong sources support.

The upstream input labels Adamar current from November 2021, although public yacht sources date launch and delivery to 2024 and ADAMAR MY LLC was formed in April 2024. YachtBuyer and the input report 299 GT, while SuperYacht Times reports 305 GT. The authoritative input remains unchanged; the chronology and tonnage discrepancies are excluded from both biographies.

Forbes-first searches found no dedicated profile or attributable exact-person article. Both biographies exclude vessels, source narration, private valuations, property and mortgage totals, winery rankings, promotional awards and unverified birth details.
